notes.title: Important gameplay changes - Patch 2.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re happy to announce that Patch 2.02 for Krum - Battle Arena is now live! As we mentioned in our previous update, our team has been hard at work on some of the trickier gameplay issues, according to community feedback.

With Patch 2.02 the team has rewritten the way the players will score in battle and upgrade defenders. This results in faster battles and way faster progression and conquering arenas in Panoria world.

What this means for you: Until now players had to fight throughout 7 waves with approximately 100 enemies. This takes about 30mins for an experience player to win, which made the game progression slower and a bit tedious. 

Now, with this patch, players will have to fight only one battle with approximately 30 enemies for 10 minutes. On beating up the enemies, the upgrade defenders options will be unlocked and also a score for the player country will be added.
This way, much more players will be able to put their country flag on the map of Panoria and hopefully it will greatly increase the map dynamics.

Additionally, this patch introduces a change UI loading screens, tutorials and changes the way objectives works.

Take care,
–haidme



Patch Notes


 One battle per arena/no waves
 Updated UI 
 Updated objectives
 Updated tutorial
 Updated sounds

notes.title: NEW ARENA - HAUNTED CEMETERY
notes.content:
ZOMBIES!

This is the third available arena in Krum. You will fight zombies in a dark and scary cemetery. It's located right next to Odrin Fortress on the world map. 

Now players will have to fight for domination on three different arenas, which should make the competition even harder and definately more fun for all.

Haunted cemetery scenery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/4da7b89e94d07ce0d087db08ec26b5914b981e5c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/8f29f16a6dd261e64ad8ada9aa799d3103d1976a.png

NEW CREATURES

There are 7 new creatures added to the game: Mr.Jones, Dr.Smith, Baba Agnes, Ivan, Doug, Clint West and The Buther.

Here are few of them:
Mr. Jones
Mr.Jones was a sexton in a church suffering from bipolar disorder, a disease that affords him periods of intense emotional pleasure but which also results in periods of suicidal depression. Eventaully this led to a ridiculous incident in which he lost his life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/0e7dcddb356d99e568d879a630afe3aec067848c.png

Dr.Smith
The late Mr.Smith was junior senator in Odrin's Senate House. His unfortunate dead was a suprise even for his most fierce enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/976c47c0b5f2ebb6504d8a426ad3c6c49de8342a.png

Clint West
Clint West was a famous sling shooter from Nadarevo land. But he wasn't killed in a shootout, he died kicked in his balls by an angry donkey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/de06dc0062968caba2c9c852485faf7e77ed1994.png



We are preparing big changes to the gameplay in the next update. It should make the battles way more competitive and funnier. 
More details are coming soon. Stay tunned!

And here are the winners from the 3rd Early Access Season

Best Country

Congrats!

See you on the arena!
Haidme

notes.title: NEW ARENA - THE SWAMP OF DEATH
notes.content:
In this major update, we are introducing a new arena - "The Swamp Of Death" and seven new enemies - Bunyip, Draug, Mokele, Donotsura, Dodomeki, Cecrops and Burzun.
Each enemy comes with its own background story, strong and weak points.


NEW ARENA - THE SWAMP OF DEATH

This is the second available arena in Krum. Our hero will face new types of enemies while roaming the swamps, which are located right next to Panoria Outpost on the world map. 

Now players will have to fight for domination on two different arenas, which should make the competition a bit harder and definately more fun for all.

The Swamp Of Death scenery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/0e5cc1bca79ff08d6c5ff32b2800cdca0e2528ae.png

This map is the next small piece of land in the huge world of Panoria, which we are trying hard to create.

Donotsura warrior approaching Krum

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/a04f6c0b3b41b41e3c39fa50e28bd9f65f8a8bb5.png

Unlike Panoria Outpost, in this arena players will be fighting mostly with their knees underwater. So be prepared for suprises.

NEW CREATURES

We added seven new creatures to the game. Players will encounter them mostly around bogs, marshes and swamps. 
Here are some of them:

Mokele

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/62c17f3421ac7e19654c86e0a9e3b3e22da1a1d0.png

The Mokele is reputed to be a large reptile-like creature, with long teeth, and blue skin. Despite being a herbivore, it is said to roar aggressively if approached by humans. It tries to kill anyone roaming in its territory.

Bunyip

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/5bf700d9317d494e16e0fd95e51f155f20b74275.png

This water spirit purportedly made booming or roaring noises. But armed with light weapon and no armor it can be easily defeated.

Donotsura

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37868521/7c06911dc4f5a047971ea11f335dce282f6819c3.png

Donotsura's body appears much like that of a human's, except that it is missing everything from the neck up.It was given to devouring human prey, especially women and children. Armed with a sword and shield makes it hard to be taken lightly.

We are leaving some creatures out of this post and for you to encounter on the new arena.

OPTIMIZATIONS AND BUG FIXES


 Various video particles optimizations
 Grass shader optimized
 Now players will not wait the intro scene to end when restarting an arena
 Player not playing running animations on arena start is now fixed
 Loading tutorial dialogs are now optimized
 XBOX / PS Controller support updates
 Various smaller bug fixes


Known issue

 Players may experience frame stuttering, right after the arena loading, but it should stop in 5-10 seconds.
We are working on resolving this inconvenience.
